title: Exact-contact FMC falling-slug to groundwater-front merge comparator
purpose: Directly test the primary-source FMC falling-slug/groundwater merge and post-merge hydrology from an exact-contact finite-volume state, avoiding the event-reachability limitation that closed D18.

predecessor_authority.D13: FMC groundwater-front branch retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D15: Exact-contact slug/groundwater merge accounting primitive passed.
predecessor_authority.D16: Falling-slug redistribution branch retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D17: Separated simultaneous surface+groundwater composition retained research candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D18: Natural D17-to-hiatus event search did not reach merge within the frozen horizon; merge hydrology remained unadjudicated.
predecessor_authority.non_authoritative_feasibility: A later duplicate-D18 synthetic half-step-gap preflight demonstrated contact-state executability but is explicitly FEASIBILITY_ONLY_NOT_CONFIRMATORY and is not scientific evidence for D19.

primary_source_authority.citation: Ogden et al. (2015), Water Resources Research 51, 4282-4300
retained_rules: falling slugs advance with Eq.19 and preserve length
when a falling slug encounters a groundwater front it merges into that front
the groundwater front is raised toward the surface by the merged slug length
capillary relaxation and finite-volume bookkeeping are mass conservative

exact_contact_initial_state.groundwater_front: H_j=lambda*abs(psi(theta_j)), using the four already-qualified D13 lambdas.
exact_contact_initial_state.geometry_contract: 0 < z_slug_top < z_slug_bottom = z_gw < 160 for every active bin.
exact_contact_initial_state.physical_profile_identity: Pre-merge slug interval [z_gw-5,z_gw] plus groundwater interval [z_gw,160] has exactly the same occupied physical interval as the post-merge groundwater interval [z_gw-5,160].
exact_contact_initial_state.merge_rule: At t=0 remove each touching slug and set H_j <- H_j+5 cm.
exact_contact_initial_state.merge_storage_requirement: Pre-merge and post-merge finite-volume storage must agree within 1e-14 cm.
exact_contact_initial_state.exact_SWAP_mapping: R16/R2 are initialized from the physical occupied interval [160-(H_j+5),160] for every active bin, which is identical before and after exact-contact representation merge.

post_merge_dynamics.bottom_boundary: fixed zero pressure head / fixed water table at z=160 cm
post_merge_dynamics.process: D13 Eq.21 groundwater-front forward-Euler step followed by conservative capillary relaxation

checks: all four exact-contact initial geometries are finite and physical
all 99 slugs per history touch but do not overlap their same-bin groundwater front
all 99 merges occur at t=0 by the primary-source rule
post-merge H_j are finite, positive and <=160 cm
exact post-merge physical state maps to R16 and R2 storage within 1e-12 cm
all 64 FMC post-merge steps complete under unchanged D13 Eq.21 plus relaxation
max absolute per-step global water-ledger residual <=1e-12 cm
internal_preflight_before_SWAP_trajector.failure_rule: Any failure closes D19 before R16/R2 generation. Do not change lambda, slug length, bins, process step, equations or exact-contact geometry inside D19.

SWAP_comparators.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth research policy with hard accepted transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm.
SWAP_comparators.initialization: exact cell-average mapping of the post-merge physical interval state

positive_rule: internal preflight passes before SWAP trajectory exposure
all four matched histories complete with integrity
FMC all-step terminal bottom-flux RMSE <= R2 with no more sign errors
FMC early post-merge total-storage, cumulative-bottom-exchange, mapped-theta and terminal-bottom-flux RMSE are each <= matched R2

successor_logic.if_positive: Retain contact/merge as qualified bounded FMC research behavior. The next priority becomes a longer purpose-specific hydraulic horizon or rainfall/ponding threshold experiment before any formal runtime frontier.
successor_logic.if_negative: Do not retune merge/contact construction. Preserve D13/D16/D17 positive non-contact envelopes and restrict FMC candidacy accordingly.
